pair_host_envelopes.reconciliation: full_total + tail4096_total - shared_input_prepare_ns; the shared phase occurs once per pair

timing_scope.backbone_dispatch: host body-call submission envelope without a GPU fence; not isolated GPU execution time
timing_scope.backbone_finite_sync: hidden/validity layout checks and all-row device finite reduction with .item() synchronization; may include preceding asynchronous device work
timing_scope.context_input_prepare: host context allocation/length submission envelope; tail4096 includes compact clone/zero/copy/length submission without a new GPU fence; queued completion is charged in backbone_finite_sync
timing_scope.full_head_dispatch: host first-three full-BF16 head-call submission envelope without a GPU fence; not isolated GPU execution time
timing_scope.head_finite_sync: head layout checks and device validity .item() synchronization; may include preceding asynchronous device work
timing_scope.host_ID_copy: device IDs .tolist() host transfer and integer conversion envelope
timing_scope.ingestion: common-clock envelope includes socket waiting and owned ingest
timing_scope.pair_wall: one shared input preparation plus both variant calls and ownership brackets; sum of attributed variant totals counts shared preparation twice, so subtract shared_input_prepare_ns once before comparing; no future-label waiting
timing_scope.proposal: each variant attributes the same once-per-pair anchor/query/RoPE preparation, then includes its context preparation, seven-row backbone/all-row finite sync, shared first-three full-head finite sync and host ID copy
timing_scope.scalar_update: host envelope; cache copy lacks a separate final GPU fence
timing_scope.shared_input_prepare: actual shared host preparation occurs once per pair and is attributed in full to each variant total; includes anchor finite synchronization, then asynchronous seven-row query/RoPE submission

caveats: Dispatch and synchronization are host envelopes, not isolated GPU kernel durations.
Compact context allocation/copy/length submission and its queued completion are included in complete proposal cost.
The persistent accepted cache and scalar ingestion remain unchanged; this is additional owned numerical scratch.
Cached absolute RoPE and identical seven query positions are retained; no sliding-window training equivalence is assumed.
Teacher agreement on one fixed panel is not native MTP acceptance or a measured serving speedup.
decision: Keep native/NPU attachment off: the compact tail reduced component cost but lost mean useful-prefix agreement on this panel.
